role: Post-hoc engineering diagnostic of existing frozen predictions; not independent validation or a confirmatory success criterion
status_at_write: Raw schema and annotation-run counts inspected; event detection outcomes not yet computed
source_population: Same nine PVS acquisitions; 60 positive annotation intervals are repeated passages, not 60 independent physical bumps
label_rule: Use original exactly-one no_speed_bump/speed_bump_asphalt/speed_bump_cobblestone rule; no_speed_bump means non-bump, not globally undamaged road; ambiguous rows excluded
annotation_event: Maximal row-contiguous positive interval; split at timestamp gaps above 0.1 s. This operational unit is an annotation interval, not a newly video-adjudicated physical event
evaluability: Include an interval only if at least one saved outer-test decision anchor falls within it. Report excluded interval counts. Evaluate each acquisition separately before aggregation
alarm: Use saved hard y_pred without probability recalibration or threshold change. Consecutive positive anchors form one alarm only if no intervening saved negative prediction, anchor-row gap equals 25, and time gap <=0.251 s. Otherwise start a new alarm
matching: Maximum-cardinality one-to-one matching between alarm clusters and evaluable intervals, with deterministic earliest interval then earliest alarm tie order; a pair is eligible only if at least one positive decision anchor lies within the interval expanded by tolerance. An alarm may count for at most one event
false_alarm: Any unmatched alarm cluster. All retained test anchors have explicit source binary labels. Rate uses explicit non-bump exposure and is task-specific, not a broad road-defect false-positive rate
exposure: Restrict raw exposure to first through last saved decision anchor per acquisition inclusive. Each unambiguous raw row contributes nominal 0.01 s; ambiguous rows do not contribute. Report non-bump and total assessed hours separately
primary_engineering_metrics: unmatched alarm clusters per non-bump hour
secondary_metrics: matched first-alarm time relative to annotation start, median and p90 in seconds; never physical detection latency
0.5 s tolerance sensitivity with same predictions and cluster rule
aggregation: Report every acquisition and every outer domain. For each axis/selector pool counts across its three disjoint outer domains, with each of the nine acquisitions used once. Do not pool axes together. No window/interval bootstrap and no claim of 60 independent events
distance_metric: Not reported in this diagnostic: source speed units and GPS exposure quality have not been independently verified for this purpose
integrity: Assert exact saved y_true equals frozen feature labels at test_indices; exact trip membership for each outer_id; every feature index covered once per axis/selector; no refit or split change; hash protocol, scripts, features, selection files and prediction files
claims: Original two-axis MAE criterion and all frozen results remain unchanged. Diagnostic does not certify an improved selector and will be reported regardless of direction
